skills.name: imagegen
skills.purpose: OpenAI's official image skill: generate or edit raster images (photos, illustrations, sprites, mockups, transparent cutouts) with GPT Image, including reference-based variants.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when a task needs a bitmap asset rather than code/vector. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY (or Codex built-in image tool).
skills.evidence: Official OpenAI; skills.sh ~5.1k installs; aitmpl 311 downloads

skills.name: algorithmic-art
skills.purpose: Creates generative/algorithmic art with p5.js (seeded randomness, flow fields, particle systems) and interactive parameter exploration.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on requests for generative art / art made with code. No API key; outputs HTML/JS.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh ~84k installs; in travisvn list; aitmpl 1.4k downloads
skills.notes: Covers the code-art (SVG/canvas) side of image creation.

skills.name: gemini-api-dev
skills.purpose: Google's official Gemini API skill covering SDK usage incl. native image generation (Nano Banana / Gemini image models), video, TTS and multimodal.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when writing code that calls the Gemini API. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY.
skills.evidence: Official Google Gemini; skills.sh ~22.7k installs
skills.notes: Broader than images; best official reference for Nano Banana via API.

skills.name: baoyu-image-gen
skills.purpose: Multi-provider image generation (OpenAI GPT Image, Google, OpenRouter, DashScope, Seedream, Replicate, etc.) with reference images, aspect ratios and batch generation from prompt files.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke for any text-to-image / batch image task; requires an API key for at least one supported provider (Bun/Node runtime).
skills.evidence: skills.sh ~33k installs; 26k-star repo
skills.notes: Part of a large Chinese-centric content suite; English works fine.

skills.name: fal-ai-media
skills.purpose: Unified fal.ai media generation via the fal MCP: text-to-image (Nano Banana), image/text-to-video (Seedance, Kling, Veo 3), TTS and video-to-audio.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on image/video/audio generation requests; requires FAL_KEY and the fal.ai MCP server.
skills.evidence: Part of everything-claude-code (271k stars); skills.sh ~8.8k installs; top result on skillsmp

skills.name: image
skills.purpose: Marketing-focused image creation: blog heroes, social graphics, product mockups, banners and brand assets, with guidance on AI generation and optimization.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'generate an image', 'hero image', 'social media graphic', etc. Works with whatever image tool/API you have connected.
skills.evidence: skills.sh ~76.5k installs and on skills.sh 'hot' list (Oct 2026); 52k-star repo; on skillsmp

skills.name: generate-image
skills.purpose: Generates or edits images through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow) for photos, illustrations, logos and compositing.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on image/illustration/logo requests (not technical diagrams). Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
skills.evidence: 47k-star repo; skills.sh ~1.8k installs

skills.name: imagegen-frontend-web
skills.purpose: Image-direction skill that generates premium website design reference images, one per page section, with enforced composition variety.
skills.how_to_use: Use to generate visual references for landing pages before coding; needs an image-generation tool (e.g. GPT Image / Nano Banana).
skills.evidence: skills.sh trending list (Oct 2026), ~330k installs; 92k-star repo
skills.notes: Install counts on skills.sh look very high; repo is genuinely popular.

skills.name: genmedia
skills.purpose: fal.ai's official foundational skill: use the genmedia CLI to search, inspect, price and run 1200+ fal model endpoints (image, video, audio) incl. queued async jobs.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'run a model', 'fal CLI', 'search models'. Needs the genmedia CLI and FAL_KEY. Companion skills fal-prompting / fal-workflow handle prompt craft and pipelines.
skills.evidence: Official fal.ai vendor repo
skills.notes: No LICENSE file (README states MIT) -> link-only.

skills.name: prompt-images
skills.purpose: Replicate's official guide to prompting image generation and editing models (Flux, SDXL, Ideogram, etc.) on Replicate.
skills.how_to_use: Use when writing prompts for image models or building image features on Replicate; pair with run-models (needs REPLICATE_API_TOKEN).
skills.evidence: Official Replicate; skills.sh ~2.2k installs

skills.name: flux-image-best-practices
skills.purpose: Black Forest Labs' official FLUX prompting guide: T2I, I2I, structured JSON prompts, hex colors, typography and multi-reference editing for FLUX.2/FLUX.1.
skills.how_to_use: Use when prompting FLUX models (BFL API, fal, Replicate).
skills.evidence: Official Black Forest Labs; skills.sh ~0.9k installs (flux-best-practices)

skills.name: bytedance-modelark
skills.purpose: Seedream stills, Seedance image-to-video, multi-reference video and video edits on ByteDance's first-party BytePlus ModelArk API, with the real gotchas.
skills.how_to_use: Needs $ARK_API_KEY. Use for Seedance/Seedream work or the cheapest working image-to-video.
skills.evidence: Written by the Skill Garden author from shipped work; cleaned public copy, MIT (3 Oct 2026).

skills.name: nano-banana-pro-openrouter
skills.purpose: Generate or edit images via OpenRouter with Gemini 3 Pro Image (Nano Banana Pro): prompt-only generation, edits and multi-image compositing at 1K/2K/4K.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on image generation/edit requests; needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY and uv/Python.
skills.evidence: GitHub's official awesome-copilot (39.6k stars); skills.sh ~10k installs

skills.name: nano-banana-pro
skills.purpose: Generate and edit images with Google's Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) API, text-to-image and image-to-image.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'generate/edit/modify this image'. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY and uv. Sibling skills nano-banana-2 and gpt-image-1-5 in same repo.
skills.evidence: skills.sh ~3.2k installs (nano-banana-2 ~0.9k)

skills.name: nano-banana-pro
skills.purpose: Peter Steinberger's Nano Banana skill: Gemini image generation/editing with 512px-4K workflows and a bundled script.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on Nano Banana/Gemini image gen/edit; needs GEMINI_API_KEY.
skills.evidence: 7.2k-star repo by a well-known developer; also distributed via openclaw

skills.name: nano-banana
skills.purpose: Nano Banana CLI skill: Gemini 3.1 Flash/Pro image generation with multi-resolution, aspect ratios, reference-image style transfer, green-screen transparent assets and cost tracking.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'generate an image / sprite / asset'. Requires the nano-banana CLI (Bun) and a Gemini key.
skills.evidence: 414 stars; skills.sh ~660 installs

skills.name: higgsfield-generate
skills.purpose: Official Higgsfield skill to generate images, video, 3D and audio through the Higgsfield CLI, routing to GPT Image 2.5, Seedance 2.5, Nano Banana 2 etc.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'generate an image / make a video'. Needs a Higgsfield account + CLI (paid credits).
skills.evidence: Official Higgsfield; repo created Apr 2026 and already 1.2k stars; sibling skills ~72k installs on skills.sh

skills.name: gpt-image-2-style-library
skills.purpose: Chooses GPT Image 2 visual styles and industrial prompt templates from the awesome-gpt-image-2 library (categories, style/scene tags, pitfalls, example cases).
skills.how_to_use: Use for prompt crafting/rewriting for gpt-image-2; no key needed (prompt advisor).
skills.evidence: 33.8k-star prompt library repo; skills.sh ~3.8k installs
skills.notes: SKILL.md is short; value is in the repo's template library.

skills.name: stable-diffusion
skills.purpose: Local Stable Diffusion text-to-image, inpainting and img2img with diffusers.
skills.how_to_use: Use for self-hosted image generation on a GPU; Python + diffusers.
skills.evidence: Part of Hermes Agent (250k stars); top hit on skillsmp image search

skills.name: imagen
skills.purpose: Generate images with Google Gemini image generation for UI mockups, icons, illustrations and concept art.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on image creation requests; needs GEMINI_API_KEY.
skills.evidence: Listed in ComposioHQ awesome list; skills.sh ~580 installs

skills.name: comfyui-workflow-builder
skills.purpose: Generates valid ComfyUI workflow JSON from natural language: txt2img, img2img, inpainting, ControlNet, LoRA stacks, upscaling, face detailing.
skills.how_to_use: Use with a local/remote ComfyUI server (COMFYUI_URL); sibling skills cover the API, prompt engineering and troubleshooting.
skills.evidence: Top ComfyUI skill on skills.sh (~1.9K installs; pack of 15 ComfyUI skills).
skills.notes: Low stars; the only substantive ComfyUI (local open-model) entry - list has none.

skills.name: image-prompt
skills.purpose: Compiles vague requests into finished gpt-image-2 prompts with category templates (posters, typography posters, promo material, looks) and a validator.
skills.how_to_use: Trigger with image-prompt requests; outputs prompts for Codex $imagegen / any gpt-image-2 tool.
skills.evidence: Repo created Jun 2026, 327 stars in ~3 months (fast-rising)

skills.name: ai-image-generation
skills.purpose: Generate images with 50+ models (GPT-Image, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve) via the inference.sh CLI: T2I, I2I, inpainting, LoRA, upscaling.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on image generation; needs the infsh CLI + inference.sh account.
skills.license: NONE (README says MIT, no LICENSE file)
skills.evidence: Previously one of skills.sh's most-installed image skills (heavily forked); 757 stars
skills.notes: No LICENSE file (README says MIT) -> link-only; many copies on skills.sh with inflated installs.
